newsitem.title: USA: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.
newsitem.headline: Assets of U.S. money market funds rose in week.

text.p: Assets of the nation's 665 retail money market mutual funds rose $2.22 billion to $590.46 billion in the week ended September 4, the Investment Company Institute, an industry trade group, said Thursday.
It said assets of the 407 taxable money market funds in the retail category rose $1.66 billion to $480.73 billion, while assets of the 258 tax-exempt funds rose $557.5 million to $109.74 billion.

The trade group said assets of the 305 institutional money market funds rose $108.7 million to $263.28 billion. Of these, the 243 taxable money market fund assets fell $1.02 billion to $233.53 billion, and assets of the 62 tax exempt funds rose $1.13 billion to $29.75 billion.
Money market mutual fund assets stood at $853.74 billion in the week. Assets for the week ended Aug. 28 were revised to $851.41 billion from $852.14 billion.
